items.name: 9 degree grooved iPad base
items.selection_reason: One 9 degree printed wedge; eight parallel 168 mm long surface recesses, width 2.5 mm, normal depth 1 mm, pitch 7.5 mm. End terrace 24 mm long and 7 mm deep retained. R3 exterior and 0.5 mm bottom chamfer. iPad slot mouth 10 mm, depth 8 mm, offset 4.434472 mm to maintain rearward 20 degrees; no slot edge rounding.

risks.description: Channel dimensions are editable defaults. Exact iPad/case fit, load capacity and tip resistance require physical verification; no specific iPad model is certified.
